India’s Quick-Commerce Disruptor Stays Calm on AI ‘Myth’
videos.description: Widely seen as the architect of the instant delivery model in India, Deepinder Goyal stays confident that the platforms he has built up under Eternal, such as Zomato and Blinkit, can harness AI for their customers better than general AI models can. As Goyal steps away from day-to-day operations of the company he has built, Bloomberg’s Haslinda Amin speaks with him in an exclusive interview from his sprawling private residence in Delhi, about his journey thus far and the pursuit of a different kind of eternity. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Schwab Is Neutral on Equities, Favorable on Commodities, Sonders Says
videos.description: Liz Ann Sonders, Charles Schwab chief investment strategist, says there is no one asset allocation that makes sense for every investor. She says the firm is neutral on equities, less favorable on fixed income, and more favorable on commodities. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: California AG Bonta on Paramount-Warner Bros., Meta and AI
videos.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta discusses his opposition to Paramount Skydance's $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Bonta also comments on the child safety settlement with Meta Platforms, the future of AI, prediction markets and the Supreme Court ruling on mail-in ballots. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
